description: This file declares the Eos class, which is a task related to WebAudio playback in the Rialto server component. It includes class definition, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references several external interfaces and context objects.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Represents an end-of-stream task for WebAudio player, managing the transition to the end state.

methods.name: Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos task with the WebAudioPlayerContext and IGstWrapper dependency.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the end-of-stream logic for the WebAudio player.
